'''Shellshock''' was a massive [[shaclaw]] that was infected with the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] during the [[Rakghoul pandemic|resurgence]] of the plague on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It resided in [[King's Pass]] until it was killed by individuals working for [[the Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization]].
